newsitem.title: USA: Weirton Steel to pay $3.2 mln civil penalty.
newsitem.headline: Weirton Steel to pay $3.2 mln civil penalty.

text.p: Weirton Steel Corp said on Tuesday it would pay a $3.2 million civil penalty under a tentative settlement it recently reached with three government agencies.

It also said it would invest about $12.2 million in environmental protection upgrades over the next four years, and spend nearly $1.6 million to improve the effectiveness of one of its waste water treatment sites.

The company said the agreement will resolve certain air, water and waste handling issues raised last year by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, the U.S. Dept of Justice and the West VIrginia Dept of Environmental Protection.
